summary: Implemented the endpoint-ruleset builtin helper and registry. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) with the eleven members and values from the spec. botocore/args.py adds compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults on ClientArgsCreator, imports the enum as EPRBuiltins after botocore.endpoint, and lets _should_set_global_sts_endpoint accept a None endpoint config. tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 23 tests covering every behavioral criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py passes (58 tests). The full unit suite has 11 failures in test_awsrequest.py and test_session*.py, which fail identically on the untouched tree. Choices: SDK::Endpoint is None when absent, so all eleven keys are always present. Nothing is committed. Not run: black/isort, which were not in the provided environment.
